spans.text: Pre-req: ollama pull gemma4:e4b && ollama serve
spans.note: The tutorial demonstrates awareness of data protection by advising against committing secrets or keys, and by using local models (Ollama) as the default path to avoid sending data to external APIs. The budget-conscious approach also implicitly minimizes unnecessary data transmission.

spans.text: Recognize when prompting hits its limit (and you need tools / agents)
spans.note: The tutorial actively promotes user agency by encouraging iterative refinement, self-checking, and critical evaluation of prompt quality. It provides multiple paths (local vs. API) and lets learners choose. It explicitly tells learners to 'Recognize when prompting hits its limit' rather than overselling prompt engineering as a universal solution.

The tutorial demonstrates inclusivity by providing the content in multiple languages (繁體中文, 简体中文, English) and offering multiple access paths (free local models vs. paid APIs) to accommodate users with different budgets and resources. The examples used are neutral and non-discriminatory.
